lifecycle.operation: Request resource with loader 0x31cab80 using authored ID; queue reference and Add state through per-thread ECS command buffer.

Resolve class with 0x32d09b0; instantiate with 0x32d0d20; virtual slot +0xf0 copies resource ID, flag, ordering argument and context string; attach via 0x3482b50; publish resulting pointer through ECS command buffer.

Load native PageResource, configure cohtml view, navigate to formatted coui URL, retain resource and page/view associations, register render representation directly or via engine render-command queue.
Readiness helper 0x3442780 checks underlying view virtual slot +0x1e0. Only then registration invokes 0x17db9f0 and queues EventHandlerRegistered marker 0x41073ce2.
Queue removal of Page and PageResource components; no direct object destruction in stream-out worker.
For each removed Page pointer: detach through 0x3482bc0, clear component pointer, invoke non-deleting virtual destructor, then engine allocator free 0x3202210.

factories.scope: Generic reflected type registry, not a UI-only widget factory. Lookup returns null on missing type; instantiation checks virtual constructibility before creation. Caller addPages assumes an authored valid type and dereferences the created page.

render_integration.view_create: Manager+0x20 virtual+0x18 receives initialized view parameters. Returned cohtml view navigates through virtual+0x10. Virtual slots are observed call sites, not a stable SDK declaration.
render_integration.thread_branch: Thread ID helper 0x318e9d0 compared with global 0x5a5d6a0. Matching thread calls render registration 0x3439660 directly; other threads queue a 0x34-byte engine command with callback 0x3443190.
render_integration.cleanup: Manager removal 0x3441e40 clears page/resource association, then directly invokes 0x3443b20 or queues a 0x1c-byte command with callback 0x3443200. The page destructor alone is insufficient cleanup.

custom_page_requirements: A valid PageResource definition and its HTML/CSS/JS resources must be available through the engine resource and coui file-routing paths. A class name or arbitrary filesystem path alone does not satisfy manager resource lookup.
Creation, event registration and removal must execute in the appropriate engine phase with valid UI manager/resource lifetimes. The renderer handoff must use the engine registration/removal paths.
CRML needs mod-owned page identity, bounded update/event serialization and cleanup at unload/reload, with readiness checks before any script or binding operation.
Widget input focus must be explicit and scoped to the page. Existing global shortcuts cannot be consumed merely because UI support is installed.
open_questions: How to mount self-authored UI resources under a unique mod namespace without replacing stock assets or accepting arbitrary filesystem access.
Whether to construct a native PageResource or reuse an existing renderer view with an isolated DOM root; neither path has been verified.
Exact cohtml API version/ABI, document-ready callbacks and event-handler deregistration guarantees.
Which lifecycle dispatch can safely service bounded native page requests, including game menu transitions and shutdown.
How HTML/CSS widgets, localization, navigation cells and focus ownership connect to engine state for a fully interactive custom page.
